notes: 'and' between 'choice' and 'mighty' answers to no waw and is added (r14). Article on הָאָבוֹת takes the 'the' before 'fathers' under r29's possessive case.

Copula 'was' on predicate noun אֲנָשִׁים, discontinuous around the numerals (r20, r25); competing placement on the numeral noted. Infinitive subject suffix unrendered since 'of them' answers to the suffix on מִסְפָּרָם.
